title: Moderate, large and super large deviations principles for Poisson process with uniform catastrophes
journal_ref: Communications in Mathematics, Volume 33 (2025), Issue 1 (April 10, 2025) cm:14900
abstract: In this paper, we expand and generalize the findings presented in our previous work on the law of large numbers and the large deviation principle for Poisson processes with uniform catastrophes. We study three distinct scalings: sublinear (moderate deviations), linear (large deviations), and superlinear (superlarge deviations). Across these scales, we establish different yet coherent rate functions.
